reason: The text fragment is the birth narrative of Moses (Exodus 2:1-10) and mentions members of the tribe of Levi (a Levite man and woman), but does not explicitly reference priests (כהנים) or depict them in any manner. The passage focuses on the protective actions of family members and Pharaoh's daughter rather than any priestly characters or functions. While Levites would later become associated with the priesthood, this account predates the establishment of the priestly order and contains no depiction of priests at all.
